**Agent Name:** Planner  
**Step Number:** 1  
**Reason for Mistake:** The Planner made an error in reasoning by misinterpreting the densities of the materials involved and applying incorrect values to them. Specifically, the stated density of feathers (~1.3 g/cm³) and iron nails (~0.8 g/cm³) is scientifically inaccurate and contradicts universally accepted values. Feathers have a much lower density (~0.0025 g/cm³ when loosely packed), while iron nails, being metallic, have significantly higher density (~7.9 g/cm³). This fundamental error led to the incorrect conclusion that the mass of feathers is greater than the mass of nails, which defies basic principles of density and volume as determinants of mass.
